description: This file defines the BudgetRepository class which provides data access methods for managing budget entities in a database. It includes methods to create, update, delete, retrieve by id, list with filters, and find overlapping budgets.

classes.name: BudgetRepository
classes.description: A singleton class that provides CRUD and query operations for budget data stored in a SQLite database.

methods.name: create
methods.description: Inserts a new budget record into the database and returns a BudgetModel with the assigned id.

methods.name: update
methods.description: Updates an existing budget record identified by its id. Returns true if the update was successful.

methods.name: delete
methods.description: Deletes a budget record by its id. Returns true if the deletion was successful.

methods.name: getById
methods.description: Retrieves a BudgetModel by its id, or null if not found.

methods.name: list
methods.description: Retrieves a list of budgets, optionally filtered by category and/or period, ordered by start date descending.

methods.name: listOverlappingRange
methods.description: Retrieves budgets overlapping a given time range, based on start and end epoch milliseconds.

methods.name: deleteAll
methods.description: Deletes all budget records from the database, primarily for testing utilities.
